fact: Presidential Decree 188/21 of 3 August 2021, in force the day after publication, ended the requirement for citizens to present a criminal record certificate, birth certificate (where they hold an ID card) and four other state-issued documents to central and local public administration services.
title: Decreto Presidencial n.º 188/21 de 03 de agosto
publisher: Presidente da República, Diário da República I Série n.º 145
